[00:22.88]祢的脚步带着我的脚步
[00:27.86]一步一步都有祝福
[00:32.89]每个脚步我要紧紧跟随
[00:37.84]走在蒙福的道路
[00:43.95]求给我更多的勇气
[00:47.15]给我更多的信心
[00:49.70]让我勇敢踏出跟随祢的脚步
[00:54.63]跟祢行在水面上
[00:57.28]跟祢走在旷野地
[00:59.87]曲曲折折我也不在乎
[01:03.82]我只要更多信靠祢
[01:07.11]只要更多顺服祢
[01:09.63]凡是出于祢的我就默然不语
[01:14.36]就算经过黑暗谷
[01:17.08]就算遇到暴风雨
[01:19.72]在祢手中都将变成祝福

syncSegmentsEn.text: Your footsteps guide mine
There is a blessing in every step
At every step I will follow You closely
I will walk the path of blessing
Give me greater courage
Give me greater faith
Let me step out boldly and follow You
To walk with You on the water
And walk with You through the wilderness
I do not mind the twists and turns
I only want to trust You more
And obey You more
Whatever comes from You, I will receive in silence
Even if I pass through a dark valley
Even if I meet a raging storm
In Your hands it will all become a blessing
